status: Persistent RGB hooks installed with explicit user approval. LED service restart and cycle/rainbow switching passed; the user physically confirmed that switching effects in the node web UI still produces normal changing colors.

evidence: ledg_scheme=4 (color cycle), re_mode=1, no active scheduler or temporary override.
Reapplying the normal SIGTSTP notification and restarting stock ledg both retained red-only channels.
In ledg initialization, 0x2569c8 reads re_mode; node branch forces steady mode and maps schemes 4/5 to scheme 2.
At 0x2579d4, node mode causes animation setup to return before starting its timer.
Additional ledg-only node branches suppress user color/pattern selection.
Isolated QEMU reproduces red-only commands in stock node mode; patched node emits exactly the stock controller commands for all modes 0 through 7.
Patched live node enabled green and blue channels, and the user confirmed physical cycling.

After the first successful RAM trial, changing the effect made ledg notify rc restart_ledg; /proc/<pid>/exe then returned to the stock /sbin/rc. The persistent event hook now replaces that stock instance after the normal restart.
root_cause.scope: This is a userspace node-mode policy in the stock applet, not evidence of damaged LEDs or a custom-kernel regression.
root_cause.closed_source: rc Makefile selects prebuilt ledg.o; ledg.c absent from this source revision. Analysis used the exact stock executable.

changes.reason: Keep selected animation instead of forcing steady color
Allow animation timer on a node

change.deployment: Version-locked copy under /jffs/ledg-node-fix/rc; only the ledg applet is launched. Merlin services-start and service-event-end hooks reconnect it after boot or start/restart_ledg. Original /sbin/rc remains unchanged.

qemu.isolation: Bubblewrap unshare-all, read-only rootfs, no router access; hardware/NVRAM/timer calls mocked.
qemu.limitation: Validates initial hardware command sequence and timer request, not physical LED output or long-running animation.

limitations: Installation is persistent and the startup script has been exercised manually; a real router reboot has not been tested.

QEMU covered initial modes 0-7. Real hardware cycle/rainbow service integration and subsequent user web UI effect switching passed; QIS/identify/SDN/night scheduling and long-duration operation remain untested.
A firmware update changing /sbin/rc intentionally disables the override until a new patch is reviewed.
No git commit or push was performed.

rollback.first_verify: These hooks were installed only because the original hook directories were empty. Verify their hashes still match before disabling them; preserve any subsequent user edits.
rollback.note: Disabling hooks before restarting is essential; otherwise restart_ledg will correctly reactivate the patch. No reboot or flash needed.

next_integration: Keep this separately approved JFFS userspace fix separate from the kernel-only firmware branch until userspace firmware integration is explicitly requested.

persistent_integration.authorization: User explicitly approved installing and permanently enabling the RGB fix, including jffs2_scripts=1.
persistent_integration.startup_order_verified: services.c calls start_ledg at line 13074 before services-start at line 13536. Startup hook manually tested and idempotent; no actual reboot performed.
persistent_integration.current_physical_confirmation: User confirmed: 切換後仍正常變色
persistent_integration.guard: Runs only on GT-BE19000AI with re_mode=1 and exact stock/patched SHA-256. Leaves stock in control after a firmware change or patched-file mismatch.
persistent_integration.scope: Userspace RGB-only follow-up, separate from the existing kernel-only firmware work. No flash, reboot, network-mode change, Git commit or push.
